<title>Balancing Sculpture Simulator</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@400;500;650&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: an elevation drawing of the piece on the left, the instrument panel on the right; stacks on phones. */
:root{
--bg:#E7EAEC; --surface:#F3F5F6; --ink:#1A2025; --muted:#5B6770; --line:#C7CED3; --metal:#7F8B93;
--accent:#1D4ED8; --warn:#A85F06; --good:#17754F;
--sans:"Hanken Grotesk",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
--mono:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){ :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
--bg:#13171A; --surface:#1B2125; --ink:#E5E9EC; --muted:#93A0A9; --line:#2D363C; --metal:#A9B4BB;
--accent:#86A6FF; --warn:#E3A545; --good:#5FCB9F; color-scheme:dark } }
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
--bg:#13171A; --surface:#1B2125; --ink:#E5E9EC; --muted:#93A0A9; --line:#2D363C; --metal:#A9B4BB;
--accent:#86A6FF; --warn:#E3A545; --good:#5FCB9F; color-scheme:dark }
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:15px;line-height:1.45;padding-inline:20px;padding-block:20px 40px}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin-inline:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
header{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:6px 16px}
h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:650;margin:0;letter-spacing:-0.01em;text-wrap:balance}
.blurb{margin:0;color:var(--muted);max-width:75ch}
.seg{display:flex}.seg button{border-radius:0}.seg button:first-child{border-radius:4px 0 0 4px}.seg button+button{margin-left:-1px}.seg button:last-child{border-radius:0 4px 4px 0}
.seg{flex-wrap:wrap}
button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
input:disabled{opacity:.45}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:820px){.main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.stage{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
#view{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;max-width:100%;touch-action:none;cursor:grab}
#view.drag{cursor:grabbing}
.state{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--bg)}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--good)}
.state[data-m="PLAY"] .dot,.state[data-m="CAL"] .dot{background:var(--warn)} .state[data-m="RECOVER"] .dot{background:var(--accent)}
.hint{position:absolute;top:46px;left:14px;right:12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;pointer-events:none}
.panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;min-width:0}
h2{font-size:12px;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 8px}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
button{font:inherit;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer}
button:hover{border-color:var(--metal)} button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
button.primary{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ink)}
.readouts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;border-block:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:12px}
.readouts div{min-width:0}
.readouts dt{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.readouts dd{margin:0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:19px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.readouts small{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
dl{margin:0}
#chart{display:block;width:100%;height:120px}
.ctl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:2px 12px;align-items:center}
.ctl label{font-weight:500} .ctl output{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted)}
.ctl input[type=range]{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.ctl .ends{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.controls{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.check{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start} .check input{margin-top:4px;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.check span{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;display:block}
#log{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-height:5.2em}
#log li:first-child{color:var(--ink)} #log b{font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;display:inline-block;min-width:5.5ch}
details{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px;max-width:75ch}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:500}
details ul{margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:18px;color:var(--muted)} details li{margin-block:3px}
</style>
<div class="wrap">
<header>
<h1>Balancing Sculpture Simulator</h1>
<div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Pendulum type"><button id="mOne" aria-pressed="true">One segment</button><button id="mTwo" aria-pressed="false">Two segments</button><button id="mTable" aria-pressed="false">Tabletop with camera</button></div>
</header>
<p id="blurb" class="blurb"></p>
<div class="main">
<div class="stage">
<canvas id="view" aria-label="Side elevation of the sculpture. Drag to push the pendulum tip."></canvas>
<div class="state" id="state" data-m="BALANCE"><span class="dot"></span><span id="stateText">Balancing</span></div>
<div class="hint" id="hint">Drag anywhere to pull on the tip.</div>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<section>
<h2>Disturb it</h2>
<div class="row">
<button id="bTouch">Light touch</button>
<button id="bPoke">Tentative poke</button>
<button id="bPush">Firm push</button>
<button id="bWhack">Whack</button>
<button id="bLetGo">Let go now</button>
</div>
</section>
<dl class="readouts">
<div><dt>Pendulum lean</dt><dd id="rLean">0.0°</dd><small id="rLeanPk">peak 0.0°</small></div>
<div><dt>Motor torque</dt><dd id="rTau">0.00 N·m</dd><small id="rTauPk">peak 0.00</small></div>
<div><dt>Tip speed</dt><dd id="rTip">0.0 m/s</dd><small id="rTipPk">peak 0.0</small></div>
</dl>
<section>
<h2>Motor torque, last 10 s</h2>
<canvas id="chart" aria-label="Motor torque over the last ten seconds"></canvas>
</section>
<section class="controls" id="camCtl" hidden>
<h2 style="margin:0">Camera</h2>
<div><div style="font-weight:500;margin-bottom:6px">Frame rate</div>
<div class="seg" id="fpsSeg" role="group" aria-label="Frame rate"><button data-fps="30">30 fps</button><button data-fps="60">60 fps</button><button data-fps="120" aria-pressed="true">120 fps</button><button data-fps="240">240 fps</button></div></div>
<div class="ctl"><label for="sLag">Lag, capture to controller</label><output id="oLag"></output>
<input type="range" id="sLag" min="10" max="120" step="5" value="30"></div>
<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="cPredict" checked><div>Predict ahead<span>Uses the motor model to carry each frame forward to the present. Off, the controller acts on the stale frame.</span></div></label>
<div class="ctl"><label for="sRoll">Camera rotation error</label><output id="oRoll"></output>
<input type="range" id="sRoll" min="-3" max="3" step="0.1" value="1"></div>
<div class="row" style="align-items:center"><button id="bCal">Calibrate on hanging pendulum</button><span id="oCal" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)"></span></div>
<div class="ctl"><label for="sTip">Mass at the pendulum tip</label><output id="oTip"></output>
<input type="range" id="sTip" min="0" max="25" step="1" value="3"></div>
</section>
<section class="controls">
<h2 style="margin:0">Tuning</h2>
<div class="ctl"><label for="sSer">Character</label><output id="oSer"></output>
<input type="range" id="sSer" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" value="0.75">
<div class="ends"><span>Alert: rises fast</span><span>Serene: rises slowly</span></div>
<div class="ends" id="serNote" hidden><span>Not used with two segments: character, linger and never-drops have no effect there.</span></div></div>
<div class="ctl"><label for="sLinger">Linger before recovering</label><output id="oLinger"></output>
<input type="range" id="sLinger" min="0" max="8" step="0.5" value="4.5"></div>
<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="cNever"><div>Arm never drops<span>The arm stays within about 45° of upright; only the pendulum falls and is pumped back. It gives up a catch sooner, so it shrugs off about half as hard a push.</span></div></label>
<div class="ctl"><label for="sTau">Motor torque limit</label><output id="oTau"></output>
<input type="range" id="sTau" min="0.4" max="7" step="0.1" value="3.5"></div>
<div class="ctl"><label for="sIdle">Restless after</label><output id="oIdle"></output>
<input type="range" id="sIdle" min="10" max="120" step="5" value="45"></div>
<label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="cFric" checked><div>Friction compensation<span id="fricNote">Off, gearbox stiction makes the one-segment arm hunt back and forth about 7° at rest.</span></div></label>
<div class="row">
<button id="bPause">Pause</button>
<button id="bSlow" aria-pressed="false">Quarter speed</button>
<button id="bReset">Reset upright</button>
</div>
</section>
<section>
<h2>What it did</h2>
<ol id="log"></ol>
</section>
</div>
</div>
<details>
<summary>What the model includes</summary>
<ul>
<li>Full nonlinear two-link dynamics with 20 × 1 mm and 16 × 1 mm aluminum tube, a 60 g elbow hub, and an estimated 0.002 kg·m² of reflected rotor inertia.</li>
<li>Motor torque limit, a 1.5 ms current-loop lag, gearbox friction (0.04 N·m stiction plus viscous drag), and elbow bearing friction.</li>
<li>A 1 kHz control loop with one sample of delay, 14-bit encoders on both joints, and velocity estimated by filtered differencing.</li>
<li>Three behaviors: an LQR balance loop, an optional linger after it is knocked over (limp, or with the arm held upright), and an energy-pumping climb back up. An arm speed governor at 7 rad/s applies in every mode.</li>
<li>Two segments: the same realism, plus a 4-second rise planned offline by trajectory optimization and tracked with time-varying feedback. It starts only once everything hangs still.</li>
<li>Tabletop: two 0.125&nbsp;m links with the middle joint locked, carrying an estimated 10&nbsp;g of joint hardware at their midpoint; the unlocked two-segment tabletop is not modelled. A gimbal motor with a 14-bit encoder for the arm, whose speed comes from a model-based observer rather than differencing encoder steps; the pendulum angle comes only from camera frames, with 0.3-pixel centroid noise on a 640-pixel image. Predict ahead replays the model from each frame’s capture time to the present, and the balance command is smoothed at 20 Hz so camera noise does not buzz the motor. The real plant differs from the controller’s model by 2–4%. Calibration lets the pendulum hang still and averages the camera’s reading.</li>
<li>Not modelled: pole flex, gear backlash, base tilt, air drag, and motor heating; for the tabletop camera, motion blur, dropped frames, lighting changes and motor cogging. The friction and rotor inertia figures are estimates, not measurements.</li>
</ul>
</details>
</div>
<script>
// Plant + controller for the balancing sculpture. Angles are absolute, measured from straight up.
const Sim = (() => {
const g = 9.81, La = 0.35, Lp = 0.45;
const ma = 0.056, mp = 0.057, hub = 0.060, Jrot = 0.002;
const I1 = ma * La * La / 3 + hub * La * La + Jrot + mp * La * La;
const I2 = mp * Lp * Lp / 3, kc = mp * La * Lp / 2;
const G1 = (ma * La / 2 + hub * La + mp * La) * g, G2 = mp * Lp / 2 * g;
const bA = 0.01, cA = 0.04, bE = 2e-4, cE = 5e-4;
const K = [-0.61922, -9.26151, -0.902871, -1.653527];
const P = [[4.034306, 7.388469, 1.430351, 1.254426], [7.388469, 35.922737, 4.717257, 4.468301],
[1.430351, 4.717257, 0.862498, 0.78071], [1.254426, 4.468301, 0.78071, 0.745047]];
const RES = 2 * Math.PI / 16384, DT = 1e-3, SUB = 4;
const wrap = a => { a = (a + Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI); if (a < 0) a += 2 * Math.PI; return a - Math.PI; };
const clamp = (v, m) => Math.max(-m, Math.min(m, v));
function deriv(x, tau, Fx, Fy, o) {
const th1 = x[0], th2 = x[1], w1 = x[2], w2 = x[3];
const s = Math.sin(th1 - th2), c = Math.cos(th1 - th2);
const fe = bE * (w2 - w1) + cE * Math.tanh((w2 - w1) / 0.05);
const fa = bA * w1 + cA * Math.tanh(w1 / 0.05);
const r1 = tau - fa + fe - kc * s * w2 * w2 + G1 * Math.sin(th1) + La * (Fx * Math.cos(th1) - Fy * Math.sin(th1));
const r2 = -fe + kc * s * w1 * w1 + G2 * Math.sin(th2) + Lp * (Fx * Math.cos(th2) - Fy * Math.sin(th2));
const det = I1 * I2 - kc * c * kc * c;
o[0] = w1; o[1] = w2; o[2] = (I2 * r1 - kc * c * r2) / det; o[3] = (-kc * c * r1 + I1 * r2) / det;
}
const k1 = [0, 0, 0, 0], k2 = [0, 0, 0, 0], k3 = [0, 0, 0, 0], k4 = [0, 0, 0, 0], xt = [0, 0, 0, 0];
function rk4(x, tau, h, Fx, Fy) {
deriv(x, tau, Fx, Fy, k1);

table: { geo: { pivot: 0.48, span: 1.15, floor: 0.1, base: [0.16, 0.012], pole: [0.012, 0.010], hubR: 0.023, arm: 0.012, pend: 0.005, elbowR: [0.009, 0.008], dims: [[0.48, 'pivot 0.48 m'], [0.88, 'upright 0.88 m']], scale: [0.2, '0.2 m'] },
pokes: [0.0001, 0.0004, 0.0012, 0.005], drag: [1.5, 0.12], torque: [0.05, 1, 0.01, 0.3],
Sim: SimT, init: () => ({}), links: S => [[SimT.La, S.x[0]], [SimT.Lp / 2, S.x[1]], [SimT.Lp / 2, S.x[1]]],
names: { BALANCE: 'Balancing', PLAY: 'Letting go', RECOVER: 'Climbing back', CAL: 'Calibrating' },
why: { 'knocked over': 'knocked past recovery, let go', 'climbing back': 'began climbing back', 'starting over': 'gave up the climb, starting over', calibrating: 'letting the pendulum hang still to calibrate the camera', calibrated: 'camera calibrated against the hanging pendulum' },
blurb: 'A tabletop proof of concept: a 0.15\u00a0m arm and two 0.125\u00a0m links on a gimbal motor, with the middle joint locked so the links act as one 0.25\u00a0m pendulum. A camera sees the pendulum; the arm angle comes from the motor\u2019s encoder.' } };
let fps = 120;
let M = MODELS.one;
let S, peaks, paused = false, speed = 1, acc = 0, last = 0, drag = null, pokeDir = 1, shownEvents = -1;
const trail = [], hist = [];
function reset() {
S = M.Sim.create(M.init());
peaks = { lean: 0, tau: 0, tip: 0 }; trail.length = 0; hist.length = 0; shownEvents = -1; applyControls();
}
function applyControls() {
if (M === MODELS.table) {
const tip = +$('sTip').value / 1000, lat = +$('sLag').value / 1000;
if (S.fps !== fps || S.tip !== tip) { S.fps = fps; S.tip = tip; SimT.configure(S); }
S.lat = lat; S.predict = $('cPredict').checked; S.roll = +$('sRoll').value * Math.PI / 180;
$('oLag').textContent = Math.round(lat * 1000) + ' ms'; $('oTip').textContent = Math.round(tip * 1000) + ' g';
$('oRoll').textContent = (+$('sRoll').value).toFixed(1) + '°';
document.querySelectorAll('#fpsSeg button').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', +b.dataset.fps === fps));
}
S.serenity = +$('sSer').value; S.linger = +$('sLinger').value; S.neverDrop = $('cNever').checked; $('oLinger').textContent = S.linger === 0 ? 'none' : S.linger.toFixed(1) + ' s'; S.tmax = +$('sTau').value; S.idleAfter = +$('sIdle').value; S.fcomp = $('cFric').checked ? 0.7 : 0;
const s = S.serenity; $('oSer').textContent = s < 0.34 ? 'alert' : s < 0.67 ? 'even' : 'serene';
$('oTau').textContent = S.tmax.toFixed(M === MODELS.table ? 2 : 1) + ' N·m'; $('oIdle').textContent = S.idleAfter + ' s of quiet';
}
['sSer', 'sLinger', 'cNever', 'sTau', 'sIdle', 'cFric', 'sLag', 'cPredict', 'sRoll', 'sTip'].forEach(id => $(id).addEventListener('input', applyControls));
const poke = J => { pokeDir = -pokeDir; M.Sim.poke(S, J * pokeDir); };
['bTouch', 'bPoke', 'bPush', 'bWhack'].forEach((id, i) => { $(id).onclick = () => poke(M.pokes[i]); });
document.querySelectorAll('#fpsSeg button').forEach(b => { b.onclick = () => { fps = +b.dataset.fps; applyControls(); }; });
$('bCal').onclick = () => { if (M === MODELS.table) SimT.requestCalibration(S); };
$('bLetGo').onclick = () => { if (S.mode === 'BALANCE' && S.selfKick <= 0) { S.selfKick = 0.35; S.kickDir = pokeDir = -pokeDir; } };
$('bPause').onclick = () => { paused = !paused; $('bPause').textContent = paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause'; };
$('bSlow').onclick = () => { speed = speed === 1 ? 0.25 : 1; $('bSlow').setAttribute('aria-pressed', speed !== 1); $('bSlow').textContent = speed === 1 ? 'Quarter speed' : 'Full speed'; };
$('bReset').onclick = reset;
function setModel(k) {
M = MODELS[k]; for (const [id, kk] of [['mOne', 'one'], ['mTwo', 'two'], ['mTable', 'table']]) $(id).setAttribute('aria-pressed', k === kk);
const tq = $('sTau'); [tq.min, tq.max, tq.step, tq.value] = M.torque.map(String);
$('camCtl').hidden = k !== 'table';
$('hint').textContent = k === 'table' ? 'Drag to pull the tip. Dashed line: last camera frame.' : 'Drag anywhere to pull on the tip.';
$('blurb').textContent = M.blurb + ' Drag the tip to push it by hand, or use the buttons.';
$('sSer').disabled = $('sLinger').disabled = $('cNever').disabled = k === 'two'; $('serNote').hidden = k !== 'two'; $('fricNote').textContent = k === 'table' ? 'Off, motor friction makes the arm hunt slightly at rest.' : 'Off, gearbox stiction makes the one-segment arm hunt back and forth about 7° at rest.'; reset();
}
$('mOne').onclick = () => setModel('one'); $('mTwo').onclick = () => setModel('two'); $('mTable').onclick = () => setModel('table');
const view = $('view'), chart = $('chart');
function fit(c) { const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(), d = window.devicePixelRatio || 1; const w = Math.round(r.width * d), h = Math.round(r.height * d); if (c.width !== w || c.height !== h) { c.width = w; c.height = h; } return d; }
// world (metres) <-> canvas: a square view sized to the model, floor a little above the bottom edge
const X = (x, W) => (x / M.geo.span + 0.5) * W, Y = (y, W) => W - (y + M.geo.floor) / M.geo.span * W;
function joints() { const pts = [[0, M.geo.pivot]]; for (const [l, a] of M.links(S)) { const p = pts[pts.length - 1]; pts.push([p[0] + l * Math.sin(a), p[1] + l * Math.cos(a)]); } return pts; }
function tipPos() { const p = joints(); return p[p.length - 1]; }
function toWorld(ev) { const r = view.getBoundingClientRect(); return [((ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5) * M.geo.span, (1 - (ev.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * M.geo.span - M.geo.floor]; }
view.addEventListener('pointerdown', ev => { drag = toWorld(ev); view.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); view.classList.add('drag'); $('hint').hidden = true; });
view.addEventListener('pointermove', ev => { if (drag) drag = toWorld(ev); });
const endDrag = () => { drag = null; S.Fx = S.Fy = 0; view.classList.remove('drag'); };
view.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag); view.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag); view.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', endDrag);
let css = {};
function readTheme() { const cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement); for (const k of ['bg', 'surface', 'ink', 'muted', 'line', 'metal', 'accent', 'warn', 'good']) css[k] = cs.getPropertyValue('--' + k).trim(); }
function drawView() {
const G = M.geo, SPAN = G.span, PIVOT = G.pivot, d = fit(view), W = view.width, g = view.getContext('2d'), m = W / SPAN;
g.clearRect(0, 0, W, W); g.lineCap = 'round'; g.lineJoin = 'round';
g.font = `${11 * d}px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace`; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
// floor and dimension lines, as on an elevation drawing
g.strokeStyle = css.line; g.lineWidth = 1 * d; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, Y(0, W)); g.lineTo(W, Y(0, W)); g.stroke();
g.setLineDash([4 * d, 5 * d]);
for (const [h, label] of G.dims) {
g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(X(-SPAN * 0.48, W), Y(h, W)); g.lineTo(X(SPAN * 0.48, W), Y(h, W)); g.stroke();
g.fillStyle = css.muted; g.textAlign = 'right'; g.fillText(label, W - 10 * d, Y(h, W) - 9 * d);
}
g.setLineDash([]);
const sx = SPAN * 0.46 - G.scale[0], sy = -G.floor * 0.35;
g.strokeStyle = css.muted; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(X(sx, W), Y(sy, W)); g.lineTo(X(sx + G.scale[0], W), Y(sy, W)); g.stroke();
g.fillStyle = css.muted; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.fillText(G.scale[1], X(sx + G.scale[0] / 2, W), Y(sy, W) - 9 * d);
// base and tapered pole
g.fillStyle = css.metal;
g.fillRect(X(-G.base[0] / 2, W), Y(G.base[1], W), G.base[0] * m, G.base[1] * m);
g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(X(-G.pole[0], W), Y(G.base[1], W)); g.lineTo(X(G.pole[0], W), Y(G.base[1], W)); g.lineTo(X(G.pole[1], W), Y(PIVOT, W)); g.lineTo(X(-G.pole[1], W), Y(PIVOT, W)); g.closePath(); g.fill();
// tip trail
for (let i = 1; i < trail.length; i++) {
g.globalAlpha = 0.5 * i / trail.length; g.strokeStyle = css.accent; g.lineWidth = 1.5 * d;
g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(X(trail[i - 1][0], W), Y(trail[i - 1][1], W)); g.lineTo(X(trail[i][0], W), Y(trail[i][1], W)); g.stroke();
}
g.globalAlpha = 1;
// arm, pendulum, joints
const pts = joints(), [tx, ty] = pts[pts.length - 1];
if (M === MODELS.table && S.lastFrame) { // what the controller last saw, drawn from the current elbow
const [ex, ey] = pts[1], a = S.lastFrame.z, L = SimT.Lp;
g.strokeStyle = css.accent; g.lineWidth = 2 * d; g.setLineDash([5 * d, 4 * d]); g.globalAlpha = 0.8;
g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(X(ex, W), Y(ey, W)); g.lineTo(X(ex + L * Math.sin(a), W), Y(ey + L * Math.cos(a), W)); g.stroke();
g.setLineDash([]); g.globalAlpha = 1;
}
g.strokeStyle = css.ink;
for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
g.lineWidth = i === 1 ? Math.max(2 * d, G.arm * m) : Math.max(1.5 * d, G.pend * m);
g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(X(pts[i - 1][0], W), Y(pts[i - 1][1], W)); g.lineTo(X(pts[i][0], W), Y(pts[i][1], W)); g.stroke();
}
g.fillStyle = css.metal; g.beginPath(); g.arc(X(0, W), Y(PIVOT, W), G.hubR * m, 0, 7); g.fill();
g.fillStyle = css.ink;
for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) { g.beginPath(); g.arc(X(pts[i][0], W), Y(pts[i][1], W), (G.elbowR[i - 1] || G.elbowR[0]) * m, 0, 7); g.fill(); }
if (drag) {
g.strokeStyle = css.warn; g.lineWidth = 1.5 * d; g.setLineDash([3 * d, 4 * d]);
g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(X(tx, W), Y(ty, W)); g.lineTo(X(drag[0], W), Y(drag[1], W)); g.stroke(); g.setLineDash([]);
g.fillStyle = css.warn; g.beginPath(); g.arc(X(drag[0], W), Y(drag[1], W), 4 * d, 0, 7); g.fill();
}
}
function drawChart() {
const d = fit(chart), W = chart.width, H = chart.height, g = chart.getContext('2d');
g.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
const padL = 38 * d, padR = 4 * d, lim = S.tmax, top = lim * 1.15;
const yy = v => H / 2 - v / top * (H / 2 - 6 * d), xx = i => padL + (W - padL - padR) * i / 499;
g.font = `${10 * d}px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace`; g.textBaseline = 'middle'; g.textAlign = 'right';
g.lineWidth = 1 * d; g.strokeStyle = css.line; g.fillStyle = css.muted;
g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(padL, yy(0)); g.lineTo(W - padR, yy(0)); g.stroke(); g.fillText('0', padL - 6 * d, yy(0));
g.setLineDash([3 * d, 4 * d]);
for (const s of [1, -1]) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(padL, yy(s * lim)); g.lineTo(W - padR, yy(s * lim)); g.stroke(); g.fillText((s * lim).toFixed(lim < 1 ? 2 : 1), padL - 6 * d, yy(s * lim)); }
g.setLineDash([]);
g.strokeStyle = css.accent; g.lineWidth = 1.5 * d; g.lineJoin = 'round'; g.beginPath();
const off = 500 - hist.length;
hist.forEach((v, i) => { i ? g.lineTo(xx(i + off), yy(v)) : g.moveTo(xx(i + off), yy(v)); });
g.stroke();
}
const WHY = { caught: 'caught itself upright', 'let go on its own': 'got restless and let go', disturbed: 'felt a disturbance, held', 'pendulum fell': 'pendulum fell, arm stayed up' };
function drawPanel() {
$('state').dataset.m = S.mode; $('stateText').textContent = (S.neverDrop && M !== MODELS.two && S.mode === 'PLAY') ? 'Arm holding' : M.names[S.mode];
$('rLean').textContent = deg(S.lean).toFixed(1) + '°'; $('rTau').textContent = S.tau.toFixed(2) + ' N·m'; $('rTip').textContent = S.tipSpeed.toFixed(1) + ' m/s';
if (M === MODELS.table) $('oCal').textContent = 'Calibration offset ' + deg(S.calOffset).toFixed(1) + '°; arm now ' + deg(Sim.wrap(S.x[0])).toFixed(1) + '° from vertical';
$('rLeanPk').textContent = 'peak held ' + deg(peaks.lean).toFixed(1) + '°'; $('rTauPk').textContent = 'peak ' + peaks.tau.toFixed(2); $('rTipPk').textContent = 'peak ' + peaks.tip.toFixed(1);
const stamp = S.events.length ? S.events[S.events.length - 1].t : -1;
if (stamp !== shownEvents) {
shownEvents = stamp;
$('log').innerHTML = S.events.slice(-4).reverse().map(e => `<li><b>${e.t.toFixed(1)} s</b> ${M.why[e.why] || WHY[e.why] || e.why}</li>`).join('') || '<li>Standing quietly. Nothing has happened yet.</li>';
}
}
let histAcc = 0;
function frame(now) {
const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000 || 0); last = now;
if (!paused) {
acc += dt * speed;
let n = Math.min(60, Math.floor(acc / 1e-3)); acc -= n * 1e-3; if (acc > 0.05) acc = 0;
while (n-- > 0) {
if (drag) { const [tx, ty] = tipPos(); const [kd, cap] = M.drag; let fx = kd * (drag[0] - tx), fy = kd * (drag[1] - ty); const f = Math.hypot(fx, fy); if (f > cap) { fx *= cap / f; fy *= cap / f; } S.Fx = fx; S.Fy = fy; }
M.Sim.step(S);
peaks.tau = Math.max(peaks.tau, Math.abs(S.tau)); peaks.tip = Math.max(peaks.tip, S.tipSpeed);
if (S.mode === 'BALANCE') peaks.lean = Math.max(peaks.lean, Math.abs(S.lean));
if ((histAcc += 1e-3) >= 0.02) { histAcc = 0; hist.push(S.tau); if (hist.length > 500) hist.shift(); }
}
trail.push(tipPos()); if (trail.length > 45) trail.shift();
}
readTheme(); drawView(); drawChart(); drawPanel();
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
setModel('one'); requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
